answer_1.quote: We test the in-context learning abilities of X-ELM on three downstream tasks: XNLI is a multilingual natural language inference benchmark... XStoryCloze (Lin et al., 2022) is a manually translated benchmark extending StoryCloze to other languages. This is a story-completion task wherein the model identifies the correct final sentence of a short story.
answer_1.outputs: The model identifies the correct final sentence of a short story; determines whether a pair of sentences are paraphrases; performs natural language inference.
